prompt: Create a provisional pixel-art OVERWORLD SPRITE INPUT SHEET for the real dog Cooper shown in the supplied reference images. Rows must be: north-facing movement (back view), south-facing movement (front view), east-facing movement (right side), west-facing movement (left side). Cooper is a quadruped small overworld character, low top-down orthographic but readable, not bipedal and not a side-scrolling battle pose. Keep a consistent footprint and baseline in every cell, with the collar readable at this scale and the silhouette recognisably Cooper. Pixel art must use hard-edged discrete square pixel clusters, limited warm late-SNES palette, no antialiasing, no blur, no photorealism, no painterly gradients, no perspective, no isometric view, no horizon, no text, no labels, no UI, no decorative collage layout. The output must visibly read as pixel art at native inspection scale and be useful as a provisional overworld sprite sheet.
